arabic text: THA YE BANU KA BAYAAN,\nKIS KO DOON AB LORIYAN
english translation text: THIS WAS BANU’S LAMENTATION,\nFOR WHOM SHALL I SING LULLABIES

arabic text: DHOOND THI PHIRTI HAI MADAR,\nHAI MERA ASGHAR KAHAN
english translation text: THE MOTHER KEPT SEARCHING PROFUSELY AND SAYING 'WHERE IS MY ASGHAR?'

arabic text: TERA JHOOLA JAL GAYA\nAI MERE TISHNA DAHAAN
english translation text: YOU CRADLE IS NOW BURNT, O’ MY THIRSTY CHILD

arabic text: KHOON BHARA KURTA TERA,\nHAYE VO BHI CHIN GAYA
english translation text: YOUR BLOOD- SOAKED SHIRT, EVEN THAT WAS PLUNDERED (BY THE ENEMY)

arabic text: AB JEEYUN KIS KE SAHARE\nPAAS MERE KYA RAHA
english translation text: HOW CAN I LIVE WITHOUT A REMINDER OF YOU, WHAT DO I HAVE LEFT NOW?

arabic text: ZINDAGI HAI RAAEGAAN\nUMR BHAR HUN NOHA KHWAN
english translation text: LIFE IS NOW WORTHLESS, I WILL MOURN FOR YOU THE REST OF MY DAYS

arabic text: HAYE WO NAZUK GALA\nTEEN DIN SAY KHUSHQ THA
english translation text: THAT DELICATE NECK, PARCHED FOR THREE DAYS

arabic text: BHAR KAY MOJAY TEER NAY WO\nISS QADAR ZAKHMI KIYA
english translation text: THE TIP OF THE FLYING ARROW, INFLICTED AN INJURY SO GRAVE

arabic text: LE SAKE NA HICHKIYAN\nTHAR HUWI KHOON SAY ZABAAN
english translation text: BLOOD DROWNED THE TONGUE, YOU COULD NOT BREATHE YOUR LAST

arabic text: KHAALI JHOOLA DAIKH KER\nAI MERE NOOR-E-NAZAR
english translation text: SEEING THE EMPTY CRADLE, O’ THE LIGHT OF MY EYES

arabic text: AANKH FARYRADI HAI MERI\nAUR ROTA HAI JIGAR
english translation text: MY EYES TEAR UP, AND MY HEART WEEPS

arabic text: SO GAYE HO TUM KAHAN\nCHAYN PAAEY KAISAY MAA
english translation text: WHERE ARE YOU SLEEPING, HOW CAN I FIND SOME SOLACE

arabic text: MEI MUSAFIR SHAAM KI\nKHATM HUD ARAAM KI
english translation text: I AM A CAPTIVE GOING TO SHAAM, MY REST IS OVER

arabic text: QAID HO KER JAA RAHI HOON\nGARD HAI ALAAM KI
english translation text: I AM GOING AS A PRISONER, THE DUST IS ALL THAT IS LEFT

arabic text: BANDH CHUKI HAI REESMA\nHUM KAHA AUR TUM KAHA
english translation text: THE ROPES HAVE BOUND (OUR HANDS), WE ARE SO FAR APART, WHERE AM I AND WHERE ARE YOU

arabic text: MEER KYA REHAN KYA\nJIS NE YE NOHA SUNA
english translation text: NOT ONLY MEER AND REHAN, BUT WHOEVER HEARS THIS NOHA

arabic text: ASHK ANKHON SE BAHA KER\nUS NE RO RO KER KAHA
english translation text: CRIES TEARS OF BLOOD AND SAYS

arabic text: HAAY WO ASGHAR KI MAA\nUFF WO TERA IMTIHAAN
english translation text: O THE MOTHER OF ASGHAR,\nYOU WENT THROUGH DIFFICULT TRIALS

arabic text: JAAM ASHKON KAY PEEYO\nAAJ KI SHAB SO RAHO
english translation text: QUENCH YOUR THIRST WITH TEARS,\nFALL ASLEEP ON THIS NIGHT

arabic text: UMR LAG JAEY HUMARI\nTUM KO TUM JEETAY RAHO
english translation text: MAY MY LIFE END SO YOU CAN LIVE ON

arabic text: TUM PE QURBAN MERI JAAN\nAI QARAAR-E-BE KASAAN
english translation text: MY LIFE BE SACRIFICED FOR YOU,\nO MY BRAVE AND LONELY CHILD

arabic text: DHOOND THI PHIRTI HAI MADAR,\nHAI MERA ASGHAR KAHAN
english translation text: YOUR MOTHER KEPT SEARCHING PROFUSELY AND SAYING 'WHERE IS MY ASGHAR?'

arabic text: DHOONDTHI PHIRTI HAI MADER\nHAI MERA ASGER KAHAN
english translation text: THE MOTHER KEPT SEARCHING PROFUSELY AND SAYING 'WHERE IS MY ASGHAR?'

arabic text: ZINDAGI HAI RAAEGAAN UMR BHAR HOON NOHA KHAWAN
english translation text: LIFE IS NOW WORTHLESS, I WILL MOURN FOR YOU THE REST OF MY DAYS

arabic text: THAR HUWI KHOON SAY ZABAAN LE SAKE NA HICHKIYAN
english translation text: BLOOD DROWNED THE TONGUE, YOU COULD NOT BREATHE YOUR LAST

arabic text: MEER KYA REHAN KYA JIS NAY YE NOHA SUNNA
english translation text: NOT ONLY MEER AND REHAN, BUY WHOEVER HEARS THIS NOHA

arabic text: JAAM ASHKON KAY PEEYO AAJ KI SHAB SO RAHO\nUMR LAG JAEY HUMARI TUM KO TUM JEETAY RAHO
english translation text: HZT ALI ASGHAR AS (A MOTHERS LAMENTATION)\nQUENCH YOUR THIRST WITH TEARS, FALL ASLEEP ON THIS NIGHT\nMAY MY LIFE END SO YOU CAN LIVE ON

arabic text: TUM PE QURBAN MERI JAAN AEY QARAAR-E-BAY KASAAN\nDHOONDTHI PHIRTI HAI MADER HAI MERA ASGER KAHAN
english translation text: HZT ALI ASGHAR AS (A MOTHERS LAMENTATION)\nMY LIFE BE SACRIFICED FOR YOU, O MY BRAVE AND LONELY CHILD\nYOUR MOTHER IS WANDERING HERE AND THERE SEARCHING, O’ WHERE IS MY ASGHAR
